title: Allows the default number of packets to use the preset number
goal: Specify default values ​​for missing parameters in function signature.
summary: material comes in packages of 6. The caller usually claims one pack, but can still explicitly claim zero or more packs.
tasks: completes supplyUnits(packs). When packs are not transmitted, it is calculated as 1 pack.
returns packs × 6, or 0 when 0 is passed in explicitly.

example.note: Default parameters only take effect for missing parameters or undefined.

hint: Write packs = 1 in the parameter list, and do not replace parameters with || in the function body.
